Stays active in the background. Automatic startup reconnects when the app opens. The kill switch keeps IPTV blocked after disconnecting. Android allows one VPN at a time.

Use one peer with AllowedIPs = 0.0.0.0/0 and, when IPv6 is configured, ::/0. Split tunnels are unsupported.
Add at least one DNS server address to the Interface section.
Could not read or save the profile. Check the file and use a name up to 64 characters. Maximum 32 profiles.
